reasoning: On the season so far the Bucks are the stronger team; with home court the Bucks start about 2 points better, in a game of about 232 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bucks (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Bucks win 58 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 204 and 253 total points.

analyst.text: Milwaukee finally snapped a 13-game losing streak, the second-longest in franchise history, with a 116-111 win in Toronto behind Tyler Herro (32 points, after 50 on Saturday) and Myles Turner (27 and 11). Brooklyn have lost Nolan Traore for 8-10 weeks with a hamstring strain. Relief at home against a short-handed Nets team leans Milwaukee.
